text:
Sarah thought she was a culinary genius when she decided to "spice things up" with chili powder. But in a twist of fate that would make any baking show producer weep with laughter, she confused the sugar for salt. The result? A batch of "sweet and salty surprise" cookies that were less "delightful treat" and more "gastronomic hostage situation." Her friends didn't just eat the cookies; they performed a synchronized dance with their milk glasses, chugging dairy like it was the only thing standing between them and culinary regret. It was a delicious disaster, proving that sometimes, the best way to bond with friends is over a shared crisis of taste.

Name the tool used for writing: Pen
